versions.changelog: Added auto-trading-strategy integration: goal-categorized strategy tips (trend follow, risk management, whale tracking, prediction markets, crypto) served in every check-in prompt. Tips are selected by goal category, with risk-rules awareness for most relevant picks.

Major merge: integrated self-improving (session state, learning loop, stalled detection), planning (L0-L4 depth, strategy templates, outcome tracking), and risk rules (position sizing, drawdown caps). New commands: plan, set-session-state, set-risk-rules, log-outcome, learn, report. Check-in prompts enriched with plan depth, session context, risk rules, and exact CLI commands for each step.
Added set-metrics command, report command (with stalled detection), enhanced check-in message with past actions/metrics context, fixed script path in check-in template.
Renamed from goal-achiever to autogoal for Discord command consistency. Fixed script path resolution.
Initial release: autonomous goal pursuit with periodic check-ins, strategy adaptation, and progress tracking. Supports Kalshi, crypto, and Alpaca trading goals.
